from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, json

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/worktrees/rollout-zombie-fix")

def run(args):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=False)

if not wt.exists():
    raise SystemExit("expected partial worktree missing")

status=run(["git","status","--short"])
diff=run(["git","diff","--","src/do_again/service/rollout.py"])
hits=sorted(str(p.relative_to(wt)) for p in wt.rglob("test*rollout*.py"))

print(json.dumps({
  "head":run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip(),
  "branch":run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip(),
  "status":status.stdout,
  "rollout_diff":diff.stdout,
  "rollout_test_candidates":hits,
},indent=2))
print("ROLLOUT_ZOMBIE_FIX_PARTIAL_AUDIT_OK")
